documents.title: Desha County 2026 budget, as filed with the state
documents.note: Posted on the Arkansas Transparency portal (artransparency.gov) in May 2026. 69 pages. Amounts are the Original Budget (detail report run 1/9/2026, before any spending); the same amount also prints as Balance and Actual Balance column. The document is a scan; it was read with optical character recognition, and every parent total was checked against its parts.
